correctness.rationale: For a maximum open packing P and a minimum maximal open packing Q, maximality of Q assigns to each x in P\Q a common-neighbor witness with some q in Q\P. For each q, at most one witness lies in P and at most one in Q, while remaining witnesses are distinct, yielding |P\Q|<=2|Q\P|+|R| and hence 2 rho^o<=n+rho_L^o. When rho_L^o=1, witnesses for the maximum packing are distinct outside it, giving 2 rho^o<=n. The odd and even extremal constructions attain floor((n-2)/2); the tree constructions and small orders reconstruct. The deposited enumeration is corroboration only.
